sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For a list of all craftable items, see Crafts.

Crafting is a Practical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Improving the crafting skill reduces the production time of items, including those produced cyclically.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Reduces item crafting time (-0.75% per level → -37.5% at Elite Level)
- Reduces all cyclic production time (except Bitcoin Farm) (-0.75% per level → -37.5% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Ability to craft up to two different items in a zone at once (Including Scav Case)

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Craft items in the Hideout
  - 1.5 points per 8 hours of crafting
  - 5 points per craft upon the end of production for alternating between 2 different crafting recipes in the same module.
  - Crafting a single recipe repeatedly in the same module will give no points.
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
